load car1 adult 4

COST: 188

The plan rescues the Dhunche group and all 5 Gajuri adults in two round trips (64 + 64 minutes). The 3 adults at Gosaikunda are deferred (60 penalty). Rescuing them would require a much longer trip, about 160 minutes, so deferral is cheaper.
